your_book:
Jaleel's book slipped today (Wednesday), roughly 0.8% on position weights, and Boston Scientific did most of the damage. BSX fell 5.84% at an 8.8% weight, which alone cost about half a point. The risk flags show its Oct 28 date as the next event, on top of a slashed FY26 growth guide (10.5% cut to 7-8.5%) and management guiding flat through Q3. The headline data doesn't say why it fell, so treat the cause as unconfirmed. The position is down 13.4% and rated HOLD-QUAL. Expand Energy (-3.22%) and A. O. Smith (-1.93%) added to the drag, and neither has a headline explaining the move. NVIDIA (-1.17%) fell with chips on worries that AI-capex funding is scarce. Broadcom rose 2.77% on the same news, so that read-through wasn't uniform.

The drift is in the AVOID-rated names. Abbott (10.7%), Rocket Lab (6.4%) and Lululemon (4.1%) together make up 21.2% of the book. Rocket Lab is down 25.2% and Lululemon 17.7%, and Lululemon's guidance cut is still unresolved. Abbott is up 18.7%, but its QARP score is 56.7 and it is the second-largest weight. For a capital-preservation book, that is the biggest gap between how the positions are held and how they are rated. Watch the BSX follow-through on Thursday, Oct 29, and whether Expand Energy keeps sliding.

attention.note: An 8.8% weight, already down 13.4% with a slashed FY26 growth guide, fell hardest today, so the thesis needs rechecking against whatever was reported.
